kind: Source and format observations, synthetic unit tests and an installed-asset sweep of the ROFF motion-path reader
claims: format boundary only; nothing is moved along a path

version1.header: identifier, version, entry count stored as a float (Raven's exporter could not write an integer)

version2.header: identifier, version, entry count, frame rate, note count
version2.entry: position offset, rotation offset, first note fired and how many
version2.afterEntries: note track: that many terminated strings

refuses: a version 1 count that is not a whole, representable number of entries
a frame rate of zero or less
an entry's note range outside the track that follows (-1 means the entry fires nothing)
a note track that is not exactly that many terminated strings ending the file

installedSweep.versionOneNote: read from the format definition rather than an observation

syntheticChecks.version2: reads with entries, rate, note count and the notes an entry fires; no notes, a track nothing points at, and an empty path all read
syntheticChecks.version1: reads with its float count; fractional, negative or absurd count refused; anything after the entries refused
syntheticChecks.malformed: wrong identifier, both unsupported versions, negative and zero counts, entries past the end, note range leaving the track, unterminated note, track not ending the file, every truncation

noRetailPayload: no retail path or asset is required, incorporated or shipped
